page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: torum perniciem publicauit. Dominicum, Francif-cum, Antonium de Padua, & Elizabetham Hun-gariæ regis filiam, in sanctos retulit: ut in festis Mendicantium fraterculorum, dum in hypocrisi res eius agerent, sanctitatis opinionem atq; autho-ritatem augeret. Carmelitis, præter asinos mas-culos, & aliquod animalium seu volatilium nutri-mentum, hoc est, lac & ova, anno Domini 1230. ni-hil possessionis admisit, cætera omnia hostiatim pe-tere iussit: ut Paleonydorus refert. Immunitatem Iudæis, in uitis Christianis regibus, pro pecunia cō-cessit: & suos usurarios, uirorum omnium pessi-mos (Parisio teste) pro nummis omni fallacia hau-riendis, in Angliam post legatos misit. Sacerdotia plura uni prohibuit, ut & inde lucrum accresce-ret: & quintam partem in Anglia, ac uicesimam in inferiore Germania, omnium ecclesiæ prouen-tuum per dictos legatos petijt. Ad uirginis Ma-riæ salutationem, & ad antiphonam (Christo ual-de blasphemam) Salue regina, quam in templis can-tari primus instituit, campanæ pulsum addidit, & Eucharistici panis elevationi tintinnabulum. Statuit, ne laici Euangelium prædicent, cuiuscun-que sint conditionis: nec ullam ualere consuetudi-nem, per quam quis inducitur ad peccandum. Dam-nari per hoc statutum deberet Missa Papistica,

page.notes: Page number "186" is partly worn; the first digit is uncertain. The first word "torum" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Printed "atq;" and "cō" are kept as printed. Spelling of u/v was normalised per rule (e.g. "uirginis" to "virginis", "Euangelium" to "Evangelium", "Salue" to "Salve"). Long s was read as plain s. "petijt" is printed with a final j and kept as printed. The catchword "quæ" is at the bottom right and is not repeated in the text.
